'''Dan Grabill''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Fargo tournament]] on 9 December 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA]], according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1534">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-11-raveling-fargo-nd-2000d1534/ raveling-fargo-nd-2000], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 11 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-11-raveling-fargo-nd-2000d1534/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
